"Политика по использованию генеративного искусственного интеллекта", adopted by Academic Council decision. Mandatory acknowledgment of generative AI (e.g., ChatGPT) in any submitted work; instructors may require abstention for specific activities or mandate prompt submission; students bear responsibility for AI-generated errors; appeal route to an Appeals Committee.

"WIUT Artificial Intelligence Strategy" — an institutional strategy (not a standalone regulation) with substantive teaching/learning/assessment provisions: AI competencies integrated across all programs, assessment redesign for "authentic and responsible use of AI", and academic-integrity principles in its core values.
